response.query: What enumerator protocols, instruments, and lab standards minimize measurement error for vine water status, soil-health metrics, and wine quality assays?
response.answer: Use soil moisture sensors, soil nutrient analyzers, and gas chromatography for vine water status and soil-health metrics; for wine quality, employ gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC).
